evidence.detail: Cross-repository and local policy selection pass through a typed SelectionInput record.
No _CHANGE_CLASS_CODES map or positional semantic input array remains.
A second real consumer uses the same typed invocation mechanism for SufficiencyInput.
Interface identity changes deterministically when an argument/enum/return contract changes.

reproduction.instructions: Run Ravel native selection tests and the ABI evolution canary against the pushed mncs-language main revision.
reproduction.result: Typed record fields and ChangeClass finite variants were encoded by the shared typed request membrane; output level and reasons remained native finite values.

summary: Ravel now invokes choose(SelectionInput) through the typed mncs.typed-call/1 boundary; its handwritten change-class code map and positional semantic input construction are removed. Doctor remains the affected scalar caller.

workaround.description: Ravel positional change-class encoding was removed; only the deprecated native select_codes compatibility callable remains.
